items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did a recording date... with Joe Turner when I recorded 'Corina Corina' with him.

ctx.x: Well, that's unfortunate that that happened. Hey, what was your first car, man?

My first car -- and this is a funny story -- I did a recording date at Fulton Studio, that was the name of it at the time, at 40th Street and 6th Avenue. And I think, if I'm not mistaken, it was a date that I did with Joe Turner when I recorded "Corina Corina" with him. So I come downstairs, and it's beginning to rain, slightly. After awhile, it started coming down a little heavy, and I'm waving for the cabs, because at that time, I didn't have any wheels on my drum case or nothing, and the studio - they didn't…
Had to bring your own stuff?
